source.title: Quantum optimization beyond qubit count by low-energy subspace sampling
source.APS_reference: M. Alonso, G. Blázquez-Gil, and P. Díez-Valle, Quantum optimization beyond qubit count by low-energy subspace sampling, arXiv:2611.32560v1 (2026).

actual_reading_scope: Official metadata and HTML main algorithm II.A Eqs.2–6/Algorithm1; II.B non-variational angle scaling; II.C ratio Eq.11 and II.D hardware including Table2/Fig3; II.E runtime; IV.C baselines; selected Appendices C,D,E,G and data availability.
Existing Sep4 quantum-advantage review Korean/English same-target/sampler-replacement comparison sections; original DQB both pages full text and visual.

verified.conditional_reduction: Frozen spins enter selected linear and quadratic coefficients; no interaction is discarded by that algebraic restriction. This is conditional optimization around a classical reference, not coherent encoding of all variables.
verified.sampler: Analytically rescaled fixed-angle QAOA; low-energy candidates, global all-m-variable bit-flip improvement and population-based next-variable selection.

heavy_hex.score_definition: r=(E-Emax)/(Emin-Emax); not fraction of correct variables

verified.runtime_scope: Fig4 different random-cubic m100–500: fixed method budgets, classical timing with uniform replacement for unexecuted instances and measured n66 QPU cost; excludes queue. Not a matched-quality end-to-end timing victory.
verified.figure: Original DQB custom numerical replot of factual Table2 values/CI, not a copied original paper figure.

recommended_public_notes: QSSD의 정규화 점수는 r=(E−Emax)/(Emin−Emax)이며 정답 변수의 비율이 아니다. 1만 변수·152큐비트·p=8·100반복은 한 차례 최적화 실행의 결과이며 명목 샷은 100만 회다. 같은 인스턴스에서 SA는0.992, HiGHS는3310초에 최적성을 증명했다.
그림1은 별도 G35(m=2000,p=4,60반복)의 세 최적화 실행별 최고 cut 점수 평균과95%CI다. 분모7687은 알려진 최고cut, SA는1000reads×1000sweeps 단일 실행이다. Heavy-hex의0.95와 분모·문제군이 다르다.
실행시간 표는 엄격한동일예산벤치마크로 설계되지 않았다. Fig4의고정예산성장 비교는별도인스턴스와측정·대체표본의범위이며 대기를제외한다. 원 DQB의제조·물류절은실증이아닌후속비교제안이다.
